records.text: The Turning Point USA succession video is doctored.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep tXoI0TTKVrs)

appearances.snippet: In fact, the donor who told me that it's doctored and is willing to go very far on this claim.

verification.notes: The claim is attributed to an anonymous donor. Online analyses allege editing or AI artifacts, but the original recording, chain of custody, and independent forensic examination are unavailable, so the clip cannot be authenticated or shown to be doctored under strict gates.

records.text: At a secondary dinner, Charlie Kirk said nothing about plans for Erika Kirk and reiterated that the board would decide what happened after him.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep tXoI0TTKVrs)

appearances.snippet: and that that is doctored, said that they similarly thought the same thing. Charlie (Charlie Kirk), you're one guy. That's why they had this secondary dinner with him after this and spoke to him about it. ... And Charlie (Charlie Kirk) never once said anything about Erika (Erika Kirk) to them, about his plans. He simply reiterated that the board would figure it out.

verification.notes: This account is attributed to an anonymous donor describing a private secondary dinner. No attendee testimony, minutes, recording, or independent reporting was located to verify what Charlie Kirk said or omitted.
